crossRefs.note: He set the one in Bethel, and the other he put in Dan.
The Lord said, “Because this people draws near with their mouth and honors me with their lips, but they have removed…
Leave them alone. They are blind guides of the blind. If the blind guide the blind, both will fall into a pit.”

people.name: Bethel
people.line: Important city in Israel, associated with Abraham and Jacob.

people.name: Samaria
people.line: Capital city of the northern kingdom of Israel; Samaritan inhabitants

translations.web: So one of the priests whom they had carried away from Samaria came and lived in Bethel, and taught them how they should fear Yahweh.
translations.bsb: Thus one of the priests they had carried away came and lived in Bethel, and he began to teach them how they should worship the LORD.
translations.kjv: Then one of the priests whom they had carried away from Samaria came and dwelt in Bethel, and taught them how they should fear the LORD.
translations.asv: So one of the priests whom they had carried away from Samaria came and dwelt in Beth-el, and taught them how they should fear Jehovah.
